messages:
ashwin: quick heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321 to bump libssl from 1.1.1 -> 1.1.2 to pick up CVE-2026-XXXX. Small changes, but CI is red on linux-baseimage tests. Can someone take a look?

maria (eng-infra): on it. I see the failing job — looks like compile error linking libcrypto in the Debian12 job. paste of last lines:
```
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lcrypto
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
 likely missing -dev package in our baseimage.

security-bot: Vulnerability alert: CVE-2026-XXXX referenced in PR #4321. Severity: HIGH. Suggested mitigation: vendor patch or upgrade to patched minor.

ashwin: thanks — I added a one-line Dockerfile change to apt-get install libssl-dev in the runtime image. patch shown in PR: 
```diff
- RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates
+ RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates libssl-dev
```
That fixed the compile locally for me.

tj: I can review — can you add repro steps? e.g., `make test-infra` or `docker build -f Dockerfile.base -t base:test .` that reproduces the link error for me locally. Also please add a CHANGELOG note and a short justification in PR body for audit.

ashwin: repro steps added to PR and I pushed a follow-up commit. `make test-infra` fails locally before the fix, passes after. Also added changelog line and CVE reference.

kevin: quick look — code and change LGTM. Two tiny nits: 1) prefer `--no-install-recommends` on the apt line, 2) squash the fixup commit. Otherwise :thumbsup:.

maria (eng-infra): agree with Kevin. Also we should rebuild our debian12 baseimage and bump the pinned tag used in Dedicated pools. I'll kick off the rebuild once this merges.

ashwin: done — squashed and added `--no-install-recommends`. ready for merge once CI is green and approvals in place.

tj: I can merge but prefer to do it in the low-traffic window — planning to merge after 16:00 PT today to avoid rolling restarts during peak. I'll also run `./scripts/rebuild-baseimage --distro debian12` and then update the baseimage tags in infra repo.

deploy-bot: Merge queued: PR #4321 added to merge queue. Auto-merge will proceed after required approvals and passing CI.

maria (eng-infra): once merged I'll coordinate tagging for Dedicated and notify SRE to watch rollback metrics for 1 hour post-deploy.

ashwin: huge thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. ping me if you want me to hold the merge or help with the baseimage job.

kevin: approved and noted. :thumbsup:

ashwin: marking this thread resolved for now — will reopen if anything pops during deploy. Thanks!
